chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: One-nighters, the private bus and weekly pay
summary: They toured everywhere on a private bus on weekly pay with itineraries made by Henderson's agent.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Where were you working. You were working like one-nighters? All across the country?
Did you go out to California?
We had a private bus, you know.
How did you all get paid? Did you get paid by the week?
So you were on salary for a week? Suppose you worked one day in that week, did you get paid still?
How would you get paid if you worked one day?
You got paid for that one day.

Yeah. ... When we'd leave New York Fletcher's agent would have all these routines made out where we were going to play. We would make a copy so we would know where to write our chicks telling them what time to meet us...
